rules: Use Exo 2 for headings and key metrics to give a tactical, command-center feel.
Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, form labels, and general UI.
Use JetBrains Mono for KPIs, timestamps, node IDs, numerical data, and time scrubber.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard Sans for headings.
Use 'tracking-tight' for large headings and 'tracking-[0.1em] uppercase' for overlines/labels.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B1221]/75 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]' for collapsible side panels, tooltips, and floating controls.
visual_enhancers.tactical_borders: Use sharp 1px borders. When active, use a 1px solid stroke with a subtle inner glow.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Critical and Warning status elements on the map should pulse and have a drop-shadow glow, e.g., 'drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(239,68,68,0.6)]'.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Full-bleed Immersive Map with Floating HUD
structure: The app must take exactly 100vh without page scrolling. Use 'overflow-hidden'.
Map Layer: The 2D Canvas is the absolute background (inset-0, z-0) covering the entire viewport.
Tactical Header: A glassmorphic top bar (z-10) holding global controls, venue selector, and user profile.
KPI Strip: Can be integrated into the header or float just below it.
Controls Panel: A collapsible glassmorphic right-sidebar (z-20, w-96). Use progressive disclosure (accordions/tabs) for crowd size, arrival curves, and AI recommendations.
Time Scrubber: Floats at the bottom center (z-20), styled like a premium video editing timeline with play/pause and 1x/2x/4x toggles.

accessibility.colorblind_patterns: Map node/edge rendering MUST include pattern variations on the Canvas (e.g., solid line for clear, dashed for moderate, dotted for warning, crosshatched/thick for critical) alongside colors.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism has a minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Never use fully transparent backgrounds under text elements.

components.buttons: Sharp, rectangular with slight rounding (rounded-md). Interaction animations scale active state.
components.panels: Shadcn Card components modified to strip white backgrounds, replacing with the defined glassmorphism utilities.
components.sliders: Shadcn Slider customized with a glowing thumb for the time scrubber and crowd controls.
components.badges: Severity badges in AI Rerouting panel: use exact severity colors with 15% opacity background and 100% opacity text/border.
components.tooltips: Hover tooltips on nodes must be snappy, dark-themed, and display occupancy/capacity metrics clearly using mono font.

motion.panels: Use smooth easing for the collapsible side panel (slide in/out with ease-out cubic bezier).
motion.canvas: Animate node size and edge color changes smoothly during playback.
motion.microinteractions: Hover states on controls should slightly increase border opacity (e.g., border-white/30) and text brightness.

background_map_hint.description: Aerial view of a stadium at night. Use as a highly muted background (opacity 10-15%) under the Canvas graph to give physical context, or use it as a thumbnail for preset layout selections.

user_avatar.description: Security chief portrait to be used for the logged-in user avatar in the Tactical Header.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Map is the hero (100vh/100vw). Controls float over it.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for all panels overlaying the map.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions instead.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations and explicit hover/focus/active states.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing (e.g., p-6) inside floating panels.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive and key informational elements (kebab-case, role-based).
Use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, tabs, and sliders, heavily customizing their visual style.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup the basic App.js with routing/state for a real-time SPA dashboard.
3. Build the primary 2D Canvas component. It must span the entire screen (absolute inset-0) and handle node/edge rendering with dynamic severity colors AND accessibility patterns.
4. Construct the Tactical Header (glassmorphic) with the Venue selector, KPI Strip (peak congestion, clearance time), and User Avatar.
5. Build the collapsible Right Panel holding Scenario Controls (sliders, inputs) and the AI Rerouting Suggestions panel (with severity badges).
6. Build the Time Scrubber component floating at the bottom with playback controls.
7. Implement Node hover tooltips that render context-aware data.
8. Ensure the entire layout adheres strictly to the Deep Navy Dark ops aesthetic without 'Vercel-default' styles.
